item.title: Can open-weight models reverse-engineer a stripped Rust binary?
item.author: hello@eiken.dev (eikendev)
item.description: I took a stripped Rust binary from a small tool I’ve been maintaining since 2021, handed it to four open-weight models, and asked them to explain how one piece of its logic works. Each model got its own sandbox and had to work alone, without running the binary. I ran each one 3 times. The best model was never wrong. The rest were basically a coin flip, and not one of them ever came back with “I don’t know”.
